name: Orwell: Keeping an Eye On You
source:
Big Brother has arrived - and it’s you. Investigate the lives of citizens to find those responsible for a series of terror attacks. Information from the internet, personal communications and private files are all accessible to you. But, be warned, the information you supply will have consequences.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/491950/Orwell_Keeping_an_Eye_On_You/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
老大哥已经到来——而你，就是老大哥。调查公民的生活，找出一系列恐怖袭击的幕后主使。互联网、私人通信与个人文件中的信息，都尽在你的掌握之中。但请记住，你所提供的信息，将带来相应的后果。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/491950/Orwell_Keeping_an_Eye_On_You/]Steam[/url]]
